from types import SimpleNamespace
import src.care_myocardium.training.care_ase_sampler as s
rows = [SimpleNamespace(case_id='B_case', role='actual-train', center='CenterB', t2_present=True), SimpleNamespace(case_id='C_case', role='actual-train', center='CenterC', t2_present=True), SimpleNamespace(case_id='LGE_case', role='actual-train', center='CenterA', t2_present=False), SimpleNamespace(case_id='LGE_C0_case', role='actual-train', center='CenterA', t2_present=False)]

s.load_myops_case_metadata = lambda repo_root: metadata
s.build_care_ase_case_roles = lambda repo_root, fold: rows
s._load_hard_negative_manifest = lambda repo_root, fold: {'cases': {}, 'manifest_path': 'mock', 'manifest_sha256': 'mock'}
sampler = s.CAREASEDeterministicSampler(Path('/tmp/mock_repo'), 1)
for step in range(10000):
    sampler.descriptor_for_step(step)
center_b = sampler.descriptor_for_step(10000)
center_c = sampler.descriptor_for_step(10001)
print({'center_b_group': center_b.case_group, 'center_b_center': center_b.center, 'center_c_group': center_c.case_group, 'center_c_center': center_c.center, 'status': center_b.case_group == 'complete_centerB' and center_b.center == 'CenterB' and center_c.case_group == 'complete_centerC' and center_c.center == 'CenterC'})
raise SystemExit(0 if center_b.case_group == 'complete_centerB' and center_b.center == 'CenterB' and center_c.case_group == 'complete_centerC' and center_c.center == 'CenterC' else 1)
